content: Nggǝnda Yeeso a Mbaitalami
A hu ɓengginiya Kaisar Anggusta kalɗǝ mee a thlǝɗangganda fiya na hu kutǝryid Roma.
Ndǝna katǝra thlǝtta fiya ǝnanda, a sayidɗi tsauna Karniwus ngwamna a Suriya.
Fiya na heu wunda hu talyi ndan ɗǝ ka a thlǝɗangganda kanda.
Yisufu ndǝghǝnggima malɗǝ tal Nadzarat na hur Nggalili ɗǝgha hu tal Mbaitalami ɗǝ na hur Yahudiya, tala nggǝnda kutǝra Ndauda sǝ. Yisufu ɗǝɗǝ mbǝɗaɗǝ, ƙǝsǝr nggǝɗit Ndauda ni.
Wiighǝn tǝ Mairamu ngwannǝn ka a thlǝɗangganda kanda kyab, ahu sayidɗi ndǝghǝn ahur.
Na nanda a Mbaitalami ɗi lǝghǝdgha ɓen nggǝttǝghǝn.
Nggǝt wan ˈwadghǝn nǝn hǝshin, lǝlǝɓanggǝn tǝ pam ƙǝnɗǝghǝn, hunanggǝn ahu nggam maɓiya hai, ƙǝsǝr walwanda ƙǝnna a min rongya wa.
Falafya tǝ Fathlǝngya Chinem
A ƙǝsǝr talɗi na fa lafya sǝ, na nda mǝnda a pǝpal, na nda a ƙǝla maɓiyindan ha a fǝɗigrha.
Kula sǝndǝndan sǝ, tǝ thlǝnda Faara ɓagha thlǝmandan ɓa, tǝrgha mamnggit Faara yangga hai, tǝrmanda kaan.
Tǝrgha, wan thlǝndǝɗi ndanggǝn kanda, “A tǝrǝm ɗun wa ɓa ni ɓa tǝ laɓara na mbǝnggǝn yanɗi na fiya heu ana pǝpetyid hura kaan.
A weeriya ahur tal Ndauda nggǝɗang nda tǝ Hǝrǝkrha kun hai, Ƙǝrǝsti Chinǝm.
Ənɗiya ndǝna a kyaɗang ǝnsǝnda kun, ɗunun wal wufarwee lǝlǝɓang nda tǝ pam ƙǝndǝghǝn, hunang nda hai ahu nggama.”
Kula sǝndǝndan sǝ, tǝrgha Fathlǝngya Faara hangga na a amshi, ɓanda hai, ɓa nda wal yanɗi ˈwagha hai, kanda heu a fal Faara nanda a ndaarha,

content.text: tǝ na hu ƙǝshiirha ngwa tsauka ɗǝɗemnggirha a thlǝma nafiya na Faara a tǝk mbǝndǝ ndan fa.”

content: Malna Fathlǝnggini kanda, wuɗa nda talara ɗǝ, ndangga fa lafyini ndan “Tama Mbaitalami ɗǝ ɗǝm na ǝnɗi katǝragha hai tǝ pǝrangna Chinǝm ƙǝm.”
Thliinda ƙǝkar ɗanda wal Mairamu tǝ Yisufu, na wanɗa nda kath ahu nggam maɓiya.
Nana fa lafyini wanɗi, pǝr laɓar ɗa nda thlǝghangna tǝ Thlǝnda Faara kanda.
Sǝkna fiya laɓar ɗi, kowunni ƙǝl ƙǝs mee nanda ǝnwulteena ka ǝnɗi ndana fa lafyini.
Mairamu ƙǝsɗǝ ǝnggina haya ahurghǝn, nagha a numarha atenggǝn.
Fa lafyini wuɗa nda, na nda a aah amshe yi fal Faara ka ǝnɗi sǝknanda, tǝ na nanda, nǝghǝn ƙǝla thlǝkna tǝ Thlǝnda Faara.
Ɗǝfang nda thlǝma Yeeso
Ənana wanɗi ɓeena uvaɗa, thleng muwa nda, ƙǝmɗa ɗǝfang thlǝma nda Yeeso, thlǝmɗi ɗǝfna tǝ Thlǝnda Faara kapa na nda ɗǝfghǝn hur.
Fǝr nda Yeeso ahu Wuri Faara
Ndukna farɗa ɓa, Mairamu tǝ Yisufu ǝnanda ǝnɗi thlǝkna ngyakhrha Musa tǝ ndaarha, a tsaɓangganda altendan ɗǝ, tǝrang ngganda Yeeso, ɗǝnda tǝghǝn Urshelima ɗǝ ƙǝsǝr a fǝrghǝnda a Chinǝm.
Kǝla nanǝn chichrethlee hai ahu ngyakhrha Faara, “Kala wan ˈwarha nggǝn nanda, nanda fǝranggǝn Faara.”
Na sataka nda ƙǝla thlǝkna ngyakhrha Chinǝm tǝ ndaarha, “Titiliukya sǝri ko wan kataprakkya sǝri ndǝna nda thleerha.”

A farɗi, na niifa sǝ nǝghǝn tǝ tsaurha a Urshelima, nanda aaghǝn Simiyon. Ka niifa ni, nǝn naarha ɗǝfang shilee Faara teena. Kǝmɗa nǝghǝn a ƙǝla farɗi nanda a hǝrghang nda Isǝreela. Nǝghǝn tǝ Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda.
Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda ndanggǝn niifɗi, mba a mǝra wa ƙǝl farɗi nana Ƙǝrǝsti tǝ yidwa.
Nagha Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda a shikƙǝn, kyagha Ƙǝn Faara ɗǝ, mǝmǝl tǝ sayidɗi ɓa na fa nggǝtya Yeeso ɓa tǝghǝn a Ƙǝn Faara ɓa, ƙǝla ndana hai ngyakhrha a ǝna nda.
Simiyon thlǝ wanɗa nǝn fal Faara nǝn, ndǝghǝn,
“Na nǝn ya, China, kalu mafadwa hai wiigha hu ɗǝɗemnggirha, ƙǝla tǝ thlǝkna na,”

content.text: hǝrǝkrha ǝna na a mbed fiya heu,
Kukwaryirha kyadna a fiya mbuwa Yahudaya,

content: Chin wanɗi tǝ man ƙǝsangganda mii ndan kanda ana ǝnwulteena tǝ ǝnɗi thlǝkna Simiyon aten wanɗi.

Simiyon ɗǝfanɗǝ parka kanda teena, ndanggǝn Mairamu man wanɗi “Wur Faara wanɗiya ƙǝsǝr a tsaukwa fǝlla fingya hai, tǝ thlid fingya sǝ hangga ahur Isǝreela, nǝn tsaurha ǝnsakrha a thlǝma Faara mbuwa na mid fiya sǝ hangga.
Nanǝnke, ǝn ǝnandan na ahu tendan nǝn kyarha pǝpal ɓa. Ənɗiya nǝn hatta fa kaan, ƙǝla kuthla thlaukh ƙǝlara.”
Na suhurra annabi sǝ nuwun, thlǝmnggǝn ni Hanatu, wan Famuwel turya Ashiru. Tsauɗǝ a chimarha yi hurarha mǝd kee.
Tǝrgha chimadghǝn mǝrgha. Nanǝn ya, huradghǝn kumnggit uvaɗa kap faɗa. Mbǝ malang Ƙǝn Faara wa, nǝn naarha manang thlǝm Faara nda fǝɗigrha tǝ yan fara ahu hwanda tǝ kar aama.
Mǝmǝlla sayidɗiya, kyagha ɓa nagha a usa Faara, ƙǝmɗa thlǝkɗǝ pathla aten wanɗiya a nafiya na a ƙǝla farɗi na Faara a fǝrang alteena Urshelima.
Yisufu tǝ Mairamu ngwalang nanda ˈya ndana ngyakhrha Chinǝm, wuɗa nda tal ndan ɗǝ Nadzarat na a Nggalili.
Man wanɗi, nǝghǝn tǝ kanglanggirha, lǝlǝgɗa tǝ sǝnda, nggayid Faara ƙǝm nǝghǝn tǝghǝn ha.
Yeeso, wundakhne ngguchit ahur Ƙǝn Faara
Kafad hurarha fa, fa nggǝtya Yeeso nanda ɗǝrha Urshelima ɗǝ ƙǝsǝr ka wutsǝfayid kyarhaɓa ahu sǝsaarha.
Lǝkɗangna Yeeso hurarha Kum kap sǝri tǝ nggǝtta hai, ɗenda hu wutsǝfayirha ɗǝ ƙǝla tǝ sǝsǝnna nda sa hai.
Ngwalana wutsǝfayidɗi, ƙǝs kwaman wutta nda wure ɗǝ. Tǝrgha Yeeso ishgha hai a samarha a Urshelima, kula sǝnda chin sǝ tǝ man.
Na nda a ndaarha asǝmha nǝghǝn ahur fiya, ƙǝs wiirha nda yi paara tal. Katǝrang ngganda kaɗaghǝn hai ahur shayindan tǝ ƙǝm pashiyi ndan,
nawa ndan wa. Nanǝnke, wuɗa nda Urshelima ɗǝ, ƙǝsǝr a kaɗaghǝnda a mbǝɗi.
A far ɓeena yi mahan, ɗanda walghǝn tsau ahu Ƙǝn Faara a thlǝmad famalǝmngya, ndǝghǝn a ka thlǝmarha hai, nagha ƙǝm a tsahang mee kanda ha.
Fiya na heu a mbǝɗi nanda a kang thlǝmarha fa, kanda a ƙǝs mee, wulanggǝn kanda tǝ tur sǝndǝghǝn tǝ nggǝmnda nǝn a nggǝmang kanda sǝ.
Chin tǝ man wulang teena kanda na nandan a mbǝɗi. Ndangga man, “Waana mani ǝnangna kan kee? Nggi tǝ tsu tsǝ fannan chichakh kaan, nawanan sa.”
Nggǝmanggǝn kanda tǝ ndaarha, “Kama nun kaɗa nggi? Sunggunsǝ kamɗǝ a tsawi a wuri ki Pǝpa wa?”
Sǝngwanda numadghǝn tǝ pathɗiya wa.
Thliigha mbu saman ndan nǝn, wuɗa nda Nadzarat ɗǝ heu. Nǝn naarha a na fa nggǝtyighǝn hai, man ƙǝm, ƙǝs ǝngginanǝn haya ahurghǝn.
Yeeso ƙǝl chikrha tǝ ndǝndǝlyirha tǝ tsǝrha, hu pǝmnggǝn pǝpet a mbed Faara tǝ fiya.
